mapper.select: SELECT season_alert_id, user_id, clothes_id, message, alert_date, status, created_at FROM season_alerts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND alert_date = #{alertDate} ORDER BY created_at ASC, season_alert_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO season_alerts (user_id, clothes_id, message, alert_date, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{clothesId}, #{message}, #{alertDate}, COALESCE(#{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PENDING'))
